units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:1">Esth. R. to III, 9</cite> <he>עד שנִצְּלוּ את מצרים</he> so that they ransacked Egypt.

senses.gloss: to be fit for throwing away (as נֵצֶל), to be decayed. Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵇ bot. בשר המת שנִצַּל Ar. (Ar. ed. Rome שנצול; ed. שנתוק), v. נֵצֶל.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:13">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite> <he>לא נִצַּלְתִּי מידו</he> I did not escape his power; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 750:17">Yalk. Num. 750</cite> <he>נוצלתי</he> (read: <cite ref="N01105"><he>נִיצַּ׳</he></cite>; ed. Liv. <he>נִצּוֹלְתִּי</he>).
<cite ref="Yoma 86b:8">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite> <he>כגון שבאת … ונ׳ הימנה</he> when an opportunity to sin offered itself to him once and again, and he escaped it; <cite ref="Kiddushin 39b">Kidd. 39ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:5">Esth. R. to II, 7</cite> <he>עתידין לִינָּצֵל וכ׳</he> are destined to be saved through me; <he>עתידין להִנָּצֵל על ידיה</he> be saved through her.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 164b:1-16">B. Bath. 164ᵇ</cite> <he>שלש … אין אדם ניצול מהן וכ׳</he> there are three sins which man cannot escape &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:19">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>אשתו הִצִּילָתוֹ</he> his wife saved him.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:19">Ib.</cite> <he>משה … הַצִּילֵנוּ</he> O Moses …, save us! <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:1">Sabb. XVI, 1</cite> <he>מַצִּילִין אותן וכ׳</he> we must save them from fire (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:7">Snh. VIII, 7</cite> <he>שמצילין אותן בנפשן</he> whom we must save (prevent from committing a crime) even at the risk of their lives.
Ib. 73ᵃ ניתן להַצִּילָהּ בנפשו it is a duty to save her (from rape) at the expense of the assailant’s life; a. fr.—Trnsf. (in ritual and levitical law) to protect.
Ḥull. 55ᵇ כל … מַצִּיל בגלודה every part of the skin (which has remained unaffected) protects a flayed animal from being declared ṭ’refah.
<cite ref="Chullin 55b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>מהו שיַצִּיל וכ׳</he> does it form a protection from &c.? Ohol. V, 3 <he>מַצֶּלֶת על הכל</he> protects everything in it from uncleanness; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 9:2">Esth. R. to V, 3</cite> <he>כבר הוּצְּלוּ חנניה וכ׳</he> Hananiah and his colleagues have long ere this been delivered from the furnace; a. e.
